import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { delayedJobs } from "../../../backend/schema/delayed_jobs";

export const delayedJobsCms = customizeTable<typeof delayedJobs>("delayed_jobs", {
    display: {
        title: "handler"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "priority", "runAt", "lockedAt", "failedAt", "lockedBy"],
    fields: {
        handler: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lastError: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lockedBy: {
            multiline: true
        },
        queue: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "priority",
        "runAt",
        "lockedAt",
        "failedAt",
        "lockedBy",
        "queue",
        "attempts",
        "handler",
        "lastError",
        "createdAt",
        "updatedAt"
    ]
});
